> [!summary] Data available

## Foods & dishes
- [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] 48 recipes tagged `costa-rican`; [[RecipeDB2]] ≈40 in v1; [[WorldCuisines]] 5 dishes (e.g. gallo pinto, all shared); [[FmLAMA]] 3 (olla de carne, tres leches cake, sweet corn arepa).
- Backlog: [[RecetasDeLaAbuela]] (priority 3, open-download): Spanish-language recipes labelled by Spanish-speaking country; per-country counts not known yet.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 109 plants; [[NPASS]] 14 specimen pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Exposome-Explorer]]: 789 rows (212 concentrations, 577 correlations), the strongest Latin American human-evidence set.
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 32 records. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Costa Rican FCT and no dish set of its own (all WorldCuisines dishes are shared).
